identity.heroBio: Passionate backend developer and instructor with expertise in building scalable systems and APIs. Specialized in Node.js, Python, and cloud architecture. Committed to creating efficient, maintainable, and high-performance solutions.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a passionate backend developer with a deep love for building scalable systems and solving complex architectural challenges. With years of experience in the field, I've developed a strong foundation in creating robust, efficient, and maintainable backend solutions that power modern applications.

My journey in software development has led me to work with various technologies and frameworks, always staying at the forefront of industry best practices and emerging trends. I believe in writing clean, well-documented code and creating systems that are not just functional, but also scalable and future-proof.
repoLandingCopy: Specialized in Backend Engineering with a deep passion for fetching data. With over 4 years of experience, I build scalable, fast, robust, and secured applications using the most up-to-date technologies available. My forte lies in Quality Assurance and Automation - ensuring that projects meet the highest QA standards while automating any repetitive tasks to streamline processes.

When it comes to Tutoring, I find joy in sharing my knowledge with students of all ages. Whether it's explaining complex concepts or simplifying technical jargon, I can easily adjust my teaching approach to suit different age groups.
I am dedicated to continuous learning to refine my skills and stay relevant to the evolving technological fields.

workHistory.description: Developed and maintained company websites, boosting active monthly users from 300 to 1,000 and reducing page load times by 50%. Implemented backend optimizations for improved security, scalability, and database efficiency, and mentored 15 interns.

Designed and developed backend systems for LMS platforms and mobile applications, reducing API response times from 1.8s to 600ms and enhancing system efficiency by 50%. Built a secure, scalable infrastructure handling over 2 million concurrent users with a 90% reduction in downtime.

Provided hands-on training in backend web development to over 25 students, covering JavaScript, Node.js, Python, and Flask. Developed scalable backend solutions for internal projects and implemented CI/CD workflows to streamline development and deployment.
